name: Hannan (Hannan Hossain Shimul)

members.name: Hannan Hossain Shimul
members.years_active: 2024–present (public breakthrough; earlier career activity undocumented in available sources)

global_influences.evidence: Hannan's breakout track functions as a protest anthem within the July 2024 uprising context, situating his work within a broader global tradition of hip-hop as protest music; specific artist-level Western influence citations were not located in available sources.
global_influences.source: Wikipedia Awaaz Utha; Artists at Risk Connection statement

local_adaptation_notes: Hannan Hossain Shimul's 'Awaaz Utha' (released 18 July 2024, produced with collaborator SnareByt) became a defining anthem of Bangladesh's July 2024 protest movement, directly embedding Bangla hip-hop within a specific national political moment; his subsequent arrest and the international human-rights response (Artists at Risk Connection) underscore hip-hop's role as a vehicle for youth political voice in the contemporary Bangladeshi scene, extending the socially conscious thread already present in Jalali Set's work.
sound_evolution_summary: Breakthrough period (2024): rose to national and international attention with 'Awaaz Utha,' combining classic hip-hop production elements with direct, unvarnished protest lyrics; also associated with the hip-hop group Wrong Side. His documented public career is concentrated around this 2024 breakthrough moment; earlier career activity is not substantiated in currently available sources and should be treated as an open research question.
concert_culture_notes: Public visibility concentrated in the digital/streaming and protest-movement context rather than a documented conventional concert circuit; his arrest generated substantial media and public-solidarity attention.
listener_community_notes: Represents the socially-conscious, protest-oriented strand of the Bangladeshi hip-hop listener community, giving voice to underrepresented youth and drawing solidarity from both domestic fans and international human-rights/artist-advocacy organizations.
